data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew ben ('son') and tsion ('Zion'), meaning 'son of promise' or 'son of the right hand'. In the Bible, Bencion is a name given to several individuals, including one of the sons of Jacob. The name Bencion carries the meaning “Son of promise” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Bencion usually hope their child will grow to embody son of promise and live with faith, good character and purpose.
